• Approximate age  
• Is it a tank in a garage/closet/basement, or a tankless unit?

3) What’s happening now?  
• Slow leak / occasional drip / active flooding?  
• Is the heater still working (producing hot water)?

4) Timing and urgency  
• How urgent is this? emergency (need someone today), same_day, or routine?  
• Preferred date (YYYY-MM-DD):  
• Preferred time window: morning / afternoon / evening or a specific window like “09:00-12:00”:
